Title: Help LSJ, I will lose a Cherry Coke...

Messages.Author: Chwizz
Messages.Body:
I've got two rulings questions :

first, Body Arsenal. I want to know when a Choose Strike Phase ends ?
I explain : Player one strikes with hands, player two strikes however
he wants, then player one plays Body Arsenal at superior. Is it legal ?
I don't know, since I saw this rule on the Official Clarifications :
" The damage modifier must be played before the end of the Choose
Strike phase in order to affect the current strike. [RTR 19960112] "

second, when I play a legal manipulation (for example), can I burn my
concoction of vitality to make my action unblocable, since I don't
player further cards requiring disciplines ? Or do I need to act
without discipline since the beginning ?

Thanks very much

PS : I bet a Cherry Coke with the Prince of Paris, and I think i will
lose :(

I'm not LSJ, but

> first, Body Arsenal. I want to know when a Choose Strike Phase ends ?
> I explain : Player one strikes with hands, player two strikes however
> he wants, then player one plays Body Arsenal at superior. Is it legal

Yes, like claws this is legal too.

> I don't know, since I saw this rule on the Official Clarifications :
> " The damage modifier must be played before the end of the Choose
> Strike phase in order to affect the current strike. [RTR 19960112] "
>
> second, when I play a legal manipulation (for example), can I burn my
> concoction of vitality to make my action unblocable, since I don't
> player further cards requiring disciplines ? Or do I need to act
> without discipline since the beginning ?

yep, legal, once it's burned, then no more disciple based cards.

>
